mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases are not followed by tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or UNRATE decreases are not followed by increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or RSAFS increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decreases are not followed by negative earnings revisions.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combination signals aggressive inflation fighting by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL is not followed by tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease is not followed by increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or HOUST decreases are not followed by broader economic slowdown indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% in the same period, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of slow GDPC1 growth and INDPRO decrease is not followed by negative earnings revisions.
